title: McKinsey is making job applicants spar with a fake AI client
hook_text: McKinsey is testing job applicants with an AI.
hook_before: McKinsey and Company is making entry level candidates have a ten minute conversation with an AI simulation of a client.
script:
Ten minutes with a fake AI client is now a job requirement.
The Wall Street Journal revealed the consulting firm uses this tool as part of its hiring process.
The AI tool aims to reflect eighty percent of the scenarios consultants encounter in their day to day work.
Applicants must negotiate and solve problems directly with the software before getting hired.
Would you pass a robot client exam?
